verdict.rationale: BugSnag's first-party docs say events are grouped by error class plus the file and line number of the top in-project stack frame, and the dashboard shows the reason for each grouping. The same docs state that "a range of custom options are available" to tailor grouping per project, which covers both halves of the story. Missing for 10: any detail on the specific grouping-customization mechanisms (e.g., custom fingerprint rules, merging or splitting errors), and independent or hands-on corroboration that grouping and its customization work well.
